headline: Trump administration establishes 'Pax Silica' fund to bolster domestic supply chains and curb global tech dependencies.
summary: This new fund signals a significant US government initiative to reduce reliance on foreign supply chains for critical materials, including semiconductors and potentially rare earths, impacting global trade dynamics. It aims to strengthen domestic AI infrastructure and semiconductor fabrication capabilities, driving a long-term shift in geopolitical tech strategies and supply chain resilience.
